clue.text: The new local tea place

indicators.note: new signals that the words local and tea are made over into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A tea room has just opened in the neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' looks like it describes the local tea place, but it is the anagram signal working on LOCAL TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: To place something is to assign or put it in position, which is what allotting does.

clue.text: Really likes a great many minerals

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a great many
ores are minerals mined for their metal

explanation.surface: Someone is very keen on a huge collection of minerals.
explanation.walkthrough: D, the Roman numeral for 500, stands in for 'a great many'.
explanation.definitionFit: To really like someone or something is to be fond of it to the point of worship.

clue.text: The young create disorder

definitions.meaning: a brood of newborn animals, such as puppies born together
to scatter rubbish about, making a place untidy

explanation.surface: Young people make a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: A brood of puppies or kittens is one sense; strewing rubbish untidily is the other.

clue.text: Finding fault is all-important

definitions.meaning: disapproving, inclined to censure
crucial, at a decisive point

explanation.surface: Nitpicking matters above all else.
explanation.definitionFit: A carping reviewer is disparaging, while a crucial moment is decisive: two senses of one adjective.

clue.text: Row resulting from upsetting article on the queen

indicators.note: in a down entry, upsetting turns the word above it upside down, so it is read backwards

parts.note: IT is an item or thing, an article
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

explanation.surface: A quarrel breaks out after an article knocks the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'upsetting' turns the short word upside down; 'Row' suggests a quarrel but means a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one level in a series of rising rows, as of seats in a theatre.

clue.text: A trying put-off

parts.note: trying is read as conducting a trial in court; a postponement of the case, with the accused sent back into custody

explanation.surface: An annoying delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trying' seems to mean tiresome, but it is the legal sense: a court adjourning a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A court adjourning a hearing and sending the accused back to wait is exactly a postponement of the trial.

clue.text: Mistakes a defector admitted in time

indicators.note: admitted in means one word is let inside another

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a rat is one who deserts his side

explanation.surface: A turncoat's errors were acknowledged in good time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a defector' reads as a person in the story, but the rat is the traitor of slang, let inside the period of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Errata is the Latin plural for printing errors, listed as corrections in a book.

clue.text: Cut a date perhaps when so moved

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the words Cut a date could be arranged in another order

explanation.surface: Someone is so moved they shorten a date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges CUT A DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To be actuated is to be prompted or driven to act by some motive.

clue.text: Just the same, people should get a gift

parts.note: DO is short for ditto, the same again
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Everyone ought to receive a present all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: DO is the abbreviation of ditto, used in lists for 'the same as above'.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift given to a cause or charity is a contribution.

clue.text: Plainly he won't have the entr!

definitions.text: Plainly he won't have the entr!

parts.words: Plainly he won't have the entr!
parts.note: the word entrée is printed without its ending, so the clue itself lacks the entrée, the right of admission to a set

explanation.surface: A man evidently barred from entry.
explanation.walkthrough: The truncated 'entr!' is the joke: the clue literally has no entrée, the privilege of admission that someone not belonging to a circle lacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone not accepted into a group lacks the privilege of entry to it.

clue.text: A French boy wanting transport to school

parts.note: BR is British Rail, a transport system
Eton is the English public school

explanation.surface: A French lad needs a lift to school.
explanation.walkthrough: BR was British Rail; ETON is the famous English boarding school. 'wanting' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Brittany in north-west France is a Frenchman of that region.

clue.text: Crushed to produce fine stuff

definitions.meaning: beaten, defeated utterly
a smooth woollen cloth of good quality

explanation.surface: Something is pressed to make fine material.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is defeated, as in an opponent bested; the other is a smooth wool fabric named after a Norfolk village.

clue.text: This provides cover for the viewer

definitions.text: This provides cover for the viewer

parts.words: This provides cover for the viewer
parts.note: the viewer is read as the eye, and the cover is the fold of skin that shuts over it

explanation.surface: Something shields a person watching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewer' suggests a spectator or television watcher, but it is the eye itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The skin flap that closes over the eye protects it, a lid for the organ of sight.

clue.text: Agreement to effect a reduction

definitions.meaning: a binding deal between parties
to shrink or become smaller

explanation.surface: A deal is struck to cut things down.
explanation.definitionFit: A binding deal is the noun; to shrink is the verb, stressed on the second syllable.

clue.text: Jerk demanding eight drachms

definitions.meaning: to move with an impatient fling of the body
eight fluid drachms make one fluid ounce

explanation.surface: A fool insists on a sum of old Greek money.
explanation.walkthrough: Drachms here are apothecaries' measures, not Greek coins: eight fluid drachms make one fluid ounce, written FL OUNCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Storming off with an angry toss of the body is one sense; a fluid ounce written in short form is the other.

clue.text: Giving wretched ass help maybe

indicators.note: maybe suggests the words ass help could be reshuffled

explanation.surface: Kindness to a miserable donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges ASS HELP.
explanation.definitionFit: Unlucky and unfortunate people are miserable ones.

clue.text: Courageous man idealised by Leander

definitions.meaning: a brave person admired for valour
in Greek myth Leander swam the Hellespont nightly to his beloved, a priestess of Aphrodite

explanation.surface: A brave man is worshipped by a mythical swimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave man is one sense; the priestess loved by Leander, in Greek legend, bears the same name.

clue.text: Got on, being precocious

definitions.meaning: moved forward, progressed
ahead of one's years in development

explanation.surface: Someone made progress, being forward for their age.
explanation.definitionFit: Moved forward is one sense; ahead of normal development is the other.

clue.text: Questioning the cooking method

definitions.meaning: an intense interrogation
cooking under direct radiant heat

explanation.surface: Asking about how food is prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: A searching interrogation is one sense; cooking under direct heat is the other.

clue.text: Applaud some set-up in extravagant language

parts.note: to clap is to applaud
a trap is a set-up, an arrangement to catch someone

explanation.surface: Cheer an elaborate scheme couched in flowery words.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretentious, showy talk designed to win applause is empty nonsense.

clue.text: Do some renovatory work with a mild imprecation

definitions.meaning: to mend a hole in fabric by weaving thread across it
a gentle curse, a euphemism for damn

explanation.surface: Doing up a place while swearing softly.
explanation.definitionFit: Mending socks with needle and wool is one sense; a softened 'damn' is the other.

clue.text: To irritate a woman can appear rash

parts.note: to rub is to chafe or irritate
Ella is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Annoying a lady may seem reckless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rash' reads as reckless but is the skin eruption.
explanation.definitionFit: German measles shows itself as a pink spotty eruption on the skin.

clue.text: Remain all at sea — all at sea

indicators.note: all at sea means confused, so the letters of Remain are jumbled

explanation.surface: A sailor stays bewildered on the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated phrase does two jobs in turn: the first 'all at sea' rearranges REMAIN, the second is the definition, meaning on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Anything belonging to the sea or found on the ocean is maritime.

clue.text: Doctors despicable individuals without hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes around another

parts.note: curs are contemptible people
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Medics who are nasty types act without pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but is the old sense of outside, so the curs surround the hesitation.
explanation.definitionFit: Physicians are those who heal patients.

clue.text: A plant to tantalise the inexperienced person

parts.note: to tease is to tantalise
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A plant designed to torment a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: L stands for learner, as on the L-plates British learner drivers display.
explanation.definitionFit: This prickly plant has spiny flower heads once used to raise the nap on cloth.

clue.text: The union will get everyone a nice settlement

parts.note: all means everyone

indicators.note: settlement suggests the words a nice are settled into a new order

explanation.surface: The trade union promises everybody a fine pay deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'settlement' looks like a pay deal but rearranges A NICE.
explanation.definitionFit: A pact joining parties together is a union of them.

clue.text: Smart deal!

definitions.meaning: neat and trim in appearance
deal is softwood timber from fir or pine trees

explanation.surface: A clever bargain!
explanation.walkthrough: 'deal' looks like a bargain, but it is fir or pine timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat and trim is one sense; the softwood timber called deal is the other.

clue.text: Superseded top man in a most sardonic mood

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words a most sardonic

explanation.surface: A deposed leader is in a bitter mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters inside 'mosT SARdonic'.
explanation.definitionFit: A Russian emperor was the supreme ruler, a role swept away by the 1917 revolution.

clue.text: Credit is one's solution in emergency

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S

explanation.surface: Borrowing is the answer when things go wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' gives I'S, I being one in Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A decisive turning point of danger is an emergency.

clue.text: They wrongly assume money-lenders carry cash

indicators.note: carry means the first word holds the second within it

parts.note: usurers lend money at excessive interest
P, a penny, is a small piece of cash

explanation.surface: Moneylenders hold cash and make wrong assumptions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assume' means take on power wrongfully, not suppose.
explanation.definitionFit: People who seize a throne or office without right take it wrongly.

clue.text: Academic distinction for only sixty minutes?

definitions.meaning: a university qualification such as a BA
in angle measurement, sixty minutes of arc make one unit

explanation.surface: A university qualification earned in just one hour?
explanation.walkthrough: 'sixty minutes' suggests an hour of time, but these are minutes of arc.
explanation.definitionFit: A university award is one sense; a unit of angle made of sixty arc minutes is the other.

clue.text: Offer support — and also otherwise

parts.note: a prop is a support

indicators.note: otherwise signals that the word also appears in a different order

explanation.surface: Offer backing, and other things as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'otherwise' rearranges ALSO.
explanation.definitionFit: A suggestion put forward, such as one of marriage, is an offer.
